title: Section 230.41 - Revise the Exception after the opening paragraph in Section 230.41 to read as follows:
officialText:
Exception: A grounded conductor shall be permitted to be uninsulated bare copper, aluminum, or copper-clad
aluminum when used as part of a jacketed cable assembly.
